name: Cigna Corp. v. Amara
summary: The Supreme Court held that ERISA Section 502(a)(1)(B) does not authorize courts to reform a pension plan, but that other ERISA provisions do allow equitable remedies, and clarified the scope of fiduciary liability under the statute.
significance: Interpreted ERISA's remedial provisions broadly and distinguished between the elements of a claim and affirmative defenses, relevant to the question of which party bears the burden of proving causation.
